question: Are the deposited deficient day-four libraries shifted across inflammatory RNA sets, and how sensitive are set scores and genes to individual libraries, control allele and scale?
decision: Assess whether S3B themes coexist with mixed cytokines and alternative culture-state programs and whether the next bounded comparison is informative.
strongest_rival: Rank changes may reflect sparse genes, a single library, control allele or differing recovered state mixture.
discriminator: Use all fifty mouse Hallmarks, coverage and leading edges, strict +/+ and alternate scale/rank, and drop each library with fixed size factors. Bulk composition and independence remain unresolved.
exposure_record: Published S3B–C and Dp1 patterns known. S1 qualified sample identity and unknown units. The S2 summaries and anchor directions have been read; the S3 universe, rankings and sensitivity choices were written in the amendment before S2. No adapted Hallmark scores inspected.
biological_unit: Deposited day-4 bulk RNA library; source mouse or pool unit is unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine unique BioSample and library/run accessions. Mouse/pool reuse and processing blocks are unresolved. Wang article and GEO reanalysis are shared-source evidence.
population_and_selection: C57BL/6 initially CD62L-high Tregs cultured for 96 hours with CD3/CD28 stimulation and IL-2. Viable recovered cell composition after culture is unresolved.
contrast: Deficient minus pooled control. Compare strict +/+ control, log-scale mean difference, total-depth normalization and each one-library omission.
endpoint: Signed weighted running-sum score and leading edge for each measurable mouse Hallmark, with library omission ranges for rank-eligible genes and sets.
methods: Use S2 data and software versions. Confirm recomputed S2 effects and eligibility. Unique exact Ensembl release 78 symbol within matrix; rank log2 mean-ratio, stable ID tie-break; at least ten matched genes and at least one nonmember. Score maximal absolute departure of weighted running sum (absolute rank value weights, uniform if all zero). Sensitivity uses mean log2(norm+1) difference, strict +/+, and counts per library-total scaled to geometric mean depth. Keep universe and median-ratio factors fixed for leave-one-library checks.
missingness_and_exclusions: Report unmatched, nonunique and low-count members as outside the ranked universe. Hold set estimates below ten matches. No new exclusion of libraries or Hallmarks.
multiplicity: Descriptive outputs only; no gene-level or set-level tests.
precision_basis: No sampling uncertainty is estimated for the finite deposited libraries.
interpretation_limit: No animal-population inference, cell-state or functional effect, tumor specificity or independent replication.
stop_rule: Stop on mismatch with frozen S2, duplicate set definition or missing published themes; where design remains unknown limit to descriptive score and leverage.
amendment_reason: Initial adapted breadth stage frozen after the finite-library S2 result, using the rules set in the pre-S2 amendment.
